parameters.query: SELECT office_open, office_close, office_days, timezone, owner_email, alert_topic FROM receply_clients WHERE account_id = $1

SELECT count(*)::int AS prior_msgs,
       max(created_at) AS last_seen,
       (SELECT message->>'content' FROM n8n_chat_memory WHERE session_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_content
  FROM n8n_chat_memory
 WHERE session_id = $1
